column2: # 1. Define the Master Study Area Footprint
# A pixel is "Inside" if it has > 0 valid observations over the entire 68 years.
# This creates a single-layer mask where 1 = Study Area, NA = True Background.
# We calculate how many layers are missing for each pixel THAT IS INSIDE the footprint.
# is.na(final_monthly_max) returns 1 for NA, 0 for value.
# We multiply by the master_footprint to ignore the "Ocean/Background".
# Real holes are pixels inside the footprint that have at least 1 missing month
# Plot the footprint in light grey and the holes in red
plot(master_footprint, col="grey90", main="Internal Data Gaps (Red Specks)", legend=FALSE)
